segments.en: Sayings of Rabbainu — may the memory of the righteous be for a blessing:
"In the future — the entire world will be Breslov people."
"My fire will burn until the coming of Moshiach!"

"I have nothing at all to do in this world. For for my own sake I need not do anything at all. Only I have come into the world — to bring the souls of Israel close to Hashem Yisburach — to draw down the light of Moshiach upon Israel — to bring them close to Hashem Yisburach."
